repair_feedback: Fix the critical cross-lane contract break that prevents the core apply flow from ever succeeding: (1) change bridge.requestApply to send only { confirmedDiffHash } — remove the ops key — matching the platform postApplyPlan strict schema which rejects any extra key with INVALID_QUERY; (2) add a bridge.confirmDiff(plan) method that POSTs to /confirm-diff with exactly { plan }, matching the platform confirmDiffEndpoint schema; (3) wire the confirm-diff flow in the UI so that after the user confirms a diff preview, the dashboard calls bridge.confirmDiff with a MutationPlan object (planId, scope, ruleVersion, changes, createdAt, createdBy, reason) built from the current draft state, stores the platform-returned confirmedDiffHash in state.confirmedHash, and only then enables the apply button; (4) update tests/ui/bridge.test.js assertion for requestApply to expect { confirmedDiffHash } only (remove ops assertion), and add new tests for bridge.confirmDiff posting { plan } and returning the hash; (5) add a cross-lane parity test that imports both computeScheduleDiff from src/ui/diff and computePlanHash from src/platform and proves agreement; (6) update any applyFlow tests to reflect the corrected payload sequence (confirm-diff first, then apply with hash only).
